Package httyd.battle

Class BattleSession

java.lang.Object
httyd.battle.BattleSession
public class BattleSession extends Object
Connects the BattleEngine with the bot. The GUI sends the player's choices here and asks the session to play the bot's moves one at a time, so it can show each step slowly.
